LanguageData.WillingHands.JoinRequest.Label: {PAWN_labelShort} wishes to belong
LanguageData.WillingHands.JoinRequest.Text: Over their time in your service, {PAWN_labelShort} has come to see this colony as home. Well fed, comfortable, and at ease, {PAWN_pronoun} no longer wishes to be a slave, but to stay on as one of you, of {PAWN_possessive} own free will.\n\nWill you welcome {PAWN_objective} as a colonist?
LanguageData.WillingHands.Joined: {0} has chosen to join the colony.
